session_scope_chk.name: session_scope_chk
session_scope_chk.value:
("session"."session_class" IN ('external_collaborator','funeral_home') AND "session"."scope" ? 'patientId')
        OR ("session"."session_class" = 'auditor' AND "session"."engagement_start" IS NOT NULL AND "session"."engagement_end" IS NOT NULL)
        OR ("session"."session_class" = 'staff')

session_step_up_paired_write.name: session_step_up_paired_write
session_step_up_paired_write.value:
("session"."last_step_up_at" IS NULL AND "session"."last_step_up_factor" IS NULL)
        OR ("session"."last_step_up_at" IS NOT NULL AND "session"."last_step_up_factor" IS NOT NULL)

channel_unique_subject.name: channel_unique_subject
channel_unique_subject.where: subject_id IS NOT NULL AND channel_kind IN ('care_team','on_call','bereavement','location','discipline')

channel_kind_subject_shape.name: channel_kind_subject_shape
channel_kind_subject_shape.value:
CASE channel_kind
        WHEN 'care_team'    THEN subject_id IS NOT NULL AND retention_class = 'care_related'
        WHEN 'bereavement'  THEN subject_id IS NOT NULL AND retention_class = 'bereavement' AND archives_at IS NOT NULL
        WHEN 'dm'           THEN subject_id IS NULL     AND retention_class = 'care_related'
        WHEN 'announcement' THEN subject_id IS NULL     AND retention_class = 'operational'
        ELSE                     subject_id IS NOT NULL AND retention_class = 'care_related'
      END

message_status_shape.name: message_status_shape
message_status_shape.value:
(status = 'edited') = (edited_at IS NOT NULL)
      AND (status = 'deleted') = (deleted_at IS NOT NULL)

user_notif_pref_vacation_shape.name: user_notif_pref_vacation_shape
user_notif_pref_vacation_shape.value: (vacation_forward_to_user_id IS NOT NULL) = (vacation_until IS NOT NULL AND vacation_until > NOW())

patient_identifier_sensitive_encrypted.name: patient_identifier_sensitive_encrypted
patient_identifier_sensitive_encrypted.value: ("patient_identifier"."kind" NOT IN ('ssn','state_id')) OR ("patient_identifier"."value_encrypted" IS NOT NULL AND "patient_identifier"."value" IS NULL)

ix_cr_expiring_soon.name: ix_cr_expiring_soon
ix_cr_expiring_soon.where: status = 'active' AND expires_at IS NOT NULL

cr_expires_after_effective.name: cr_expires_after_effective
cr_expires_after_effective.value: expires_at IS NULL OR expires_at > effective_at

cr_superseded_consistent.name: cr_superseded_consistent
cr_superseded_consistent.value: (status <> 'superseded') OR (superseded_at IS NOT NULL AND superseded_by_consent_record_id IS NOT NULL)

cr_revoked_consistent.name: cr_revoked_consistent
cr_revoked_consistent.value: (status <> 'revoked') OR (revoked_at IS NOT NULL AND revoked_via_id IS NOT NULL)

cr_signed_consistent.name: cr_signed_consistent
cr_signed_consistent.value: (status = 'draft') OR (signed_at IS NOT NULL AND signed_by_id IS NOT NULL)

crr_freetext_or_entity.name: crr_freetext_or_entity
crr_freetext_or_entity.value:
(recipient_kind = 'free_text' AND recipient_entity_id IS NULL AND recipient_free_text IS NOT NULL)
       OR (recipient_kind <> 'free_text' AND recipient_entity_id IS NOT NULL)

cr_revocation_staff_evidence.name: cr_revocation_staff_evidence
cr_revocation_staff_evidence.value: revoked_by_kind <> 'staff' OR evidence_document_id IS NOT NULL

encounter_late_reason_required.name: encounter_late_reason_required
encounter_late_reason_required.value: (late_entry_tier = 'normal') OR (late_entry_reason IS NOT NULL AND char_length(late_entry_reason) >= 40)

encounter_significant_late_consistency.name: encounter_significant_late_consistency
encounter_significant_late_consistency.value:
(late_entry_tier <> 'significant_late_entry')
          OR (significant_late_override_by IS NOT NULL AND significant_late_override_reason IS NOT NULL
              AND char_length(significant_late_override_reason) >= 40)

encounter_administrative_override_consis.name: encounter_administrative_override_consistency
encounter_administrative_override_consis.value:
(late_entry_tier <> 'administrative_override')
          OR (administrative_override_by IS NOT NULL AND administrative_override_reason IS NOT NULL
              AND char_length(administrative_override_reason) >= 100)

encounter_evv_missing_reason_len.name: encounter_evv_missing_reason_len
encounter_evv_missing_reason_len.value:
(evv_bracket_state IS DISTINCT FROM 'evv_missing_documented')
          OR (evv_missing_reason IS NOT NULL AND char_length(evv_missing_reason) >= 20)

encounter_voided_consistency.name: encounter_voided_consistency
encounter_voided_consistency.value:
(status <> 'voided')
          OR (voided_at IS NOT NULL AND voided_by IS NOT NULL AND voided_reason IS NOT NULL
              AND char_length(voided_reason) >= 40)

encounter_signed_has_time.name: encounter_signed_has_time
encounter_signed_has_time.value: (status NOT IN ('signed','cosign_pending','cosigned')) OR (signed_at IS NOT NULL)

encounter_care_plan_link_at_least_one.name: encounter_care_plan_link_at_least_one
encounter_care_plan_link_at_least_one.value: (problem_id IS NOT NULL) OR (goal_id IS NOT NULL) OR (intervention_id IS NOT NULL)

cosignature_request_supervisor_release_c.name: cosignature_request_supervisor_release_consistency
cosignature_request_supervisor_release_c.value:
(status <> 'supervisor_released')
          OR (supervisor_released_at IS NOT NULL AND supervisor_released_by IS NOT NULL
              AND supervisor_released_reason IS NOT NULL AND char_length(supervisor_released_reason) >= 40)

vitals_bp_range.name: vitals_bp_range
vitals_bp_range.value:
(bp_systolic IS NULL OR (bp_systolic BETWEEN 40 AND 260))
          AND (bp_diastolic IS NULL OR (bp_diastolic BETWEEN 20 AND 180))

vitals_spo2_range.name: vitals_spo2_range
vitals_spo2_range.value: spo2 IS NULL OR (spo2 BETWEEN 50 AND 100)

vitals_pain_range.name: vitals_pain_range
vitals_pain_range.value: pain_score IS NULL OR (pain_score BETWEEN 0 AND 10)

vitals_cni_reason_required.name: vitals_cni_reason_required
vitals_cni_reason_required.value:
(clinically_not_indicated_fields IS NULL OR cardinality(clinically_not_indicated_fields) = 0)
          OR (clinically_not_indicated_reason IS NOT NULL AND char_length(clinically_not_indicated_reason) >= 20)

mileage_override_reason_required.name: mileage_override_reason_required
mileage_override_reason_required.value:
(miles_driven_source <> 'manual_override')
          OR (manual_override_reason IS NOT NULL AND char_length(manual_override_reason) >= 20)

mileage_odometer_order.name: mileage_odometer_order
mileage_odometer_order.value: (odometer_start IS NULL OR odometer_end IS NULL) OR (odometer_end >= odometer_start)

hearthnote_selection_parent_xor.name: hearthnote_selection_parent_xor
hearthnote_selection_parent_xor.value: (encounter_id IS NOT NULL) <> (addendum_id IS NOT NULL)

hearthnote_output_parent_xor.name: hearthnote_output_parent_xor
hearthnote_output_parent_xor.value: (encounter_id IS NOT NULL) <> (addendum_id IS NOT NULL)

hearthnote_output_layer2_consistency.name: hearthnote_output_layer2_consistency
hearthnote_output_layer2_consistency.value:
(layer2_involved_at_finalize = false AND layer2_cipher IS NULL)
          OR (layer2_involved_at_finalize = true AND layer2_cipher IS NOT NULL)

correction_consistency.name: correction_consistency
correction_consistency.value:
(corrects_assessment_id IS NULL AND correction_reason IS NULL)
          OR (corrects_assessment_id IS NOT NULL AND correction_reason IS NOT NULL
              AND char_length(correction_reason) >= 10)
